"[Customer quote — verbatim]"

— [Name], [Role], [Business] (with permission)

We tested [workflow] with [customer] across [number] locations. Here's what changed: [specific, verified result].

This is what the pilot program is for — real workflows, honest feedback, and a product shaped by the businesses using it.

Outcomes vary by business.

👉 Want to be next? Book a meeting — link in bio.

CHECKLIST BEFORE PUBLISHING: written permission · numbers verified · customer reviewed the post · no identifying details without consent · "results vary" included.
